name: notion-comment-to-slack-thread

deploy.description: Notion -> Slack half of the thread <-> discussion two-way sync. Fires on new comments on Tasks pages (instant when deployed — ~4s measured 2026-09-01 — and the payload is the full comment object, so no fetch-back). A comment in a mapped discussion posts into the mapped Slack thread as-bot under '<author> (via Notion)', resolved via the Internal User IDs table. Comments by the sync's own integration, already-mirrored comments, and comments on unmapped discussions all exit at the free guard path.

trigger.trigger_note: Scoped to the Tasks data source — covers every task page in one trigger. Do NOT drop the scope: an unscoped poll returned nothing (verified 2026-09-01). Replaces the task doc's original catch-hook + Notion-webhook design entirely, so no webhook subscription, verification token, or signature validation exists.
trigger.params_note: datasource_id = Tasks data source in Project Management DB.

description: Notion -> Slack half of the Slack thread <-> Notion discussion two-way sync (TKT-825). New comments in a linked task discussion post into the linked Slack thread, attributed as '<author> (via Notion)'. Companion Zaps: slack-thread-to-notion-discussion (reverse direction) and slack-notion-thread-sync-sweep (resolve detection + backstop).
